The Chinese characters for Wayne

As a transliteration, Wayne is usually written 韦恩 (Wéi ēn). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Wéi

恩
ēn

Origin and meaning

Wayne comes from English and means “wagon maker (a surname)”.

About the name Wayne

Made famous by the actor John Wayne.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Wayne as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “wagon maker (a surname)”, is part of the appeal.
